title: Turn Your Weekly Routine into Claude Skills You Can Sell #Shorts
description:
Learn how to package your weekly professional routines into Claude Skill files (SKILL.md) and sell them as digital bundles using Stripe.

1. Isolate your repeated professional process into modular steps
2. Create a folder with a SKILL.md instruction file that Claude loads when triggered
3. Package 10 to 20 SKILL.md files into a zip and set up a simple one-page checkout

Tool used:
- name: Claude Agent Skills
- endpoint: SKILL.md Instruction Loading
- docs: Anthropic Agent Skills Documentation

SKILL.md (markdown) - Inside a folder named client-report-generator in your Claude environment:
---
name: client-report-generator
description: Generates a weekly advisory report from raw metrics
---

# Client Report Generator

1. Read raw metrics from input.
2. Summarize key KPI wins and losses.
3. Format as a 3-bullet advisory email.

The catch: Selling digital SKILL packs requires an existing audience or traffic source to convert buyers.

Sources for the numbers:
- Ryan Doser (ryandoser.com/claude-ai-side-hustle/)

Real ways to earn with AI, no hype - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic; Claude is a trademark of Anthropic. Education only - not financial, investment, trading or tax advice. Income numbers are what the named creators reported; results vary and nothing is guaranteed.

#Shorts #ClaudeAI #AI #SideHustle #MakeMoneyWithAI
